verdict.rationale: Three.js is explicitly a 3D graphics library (WebGL/WebGPU); the evidence pack shows no dedicated 2D-first features like sprite batching, tilemap support, or 2D physics integration as core/first-class offerings — only CSS3D/SVG renderers exist as addons and 3D scene/geometry examples dominate. No mention of sprites, tilemaps, or 2D physics anywhere in the evidence.
